chunks: He said: Abul Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Qawlawayh, may Allah have mercy on him, reported to me, he said: al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn Amir narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Alawiyyah, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi, he said: Tawbah ibn al-Khalil informed us, he said: Uthman ibn Isa informed us, he said: Abu Abd al-Rahman narrated to us, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both, he said:

While the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family, was on a journey, he dismounted and prostrated five prostrations. When he mounted, some of his companions said: We saw you, O Messenger of Allah, do something you never did before. He said: Yes, Jibreel came to me and gave me glad tidings that Ali is in Paradise, so I prostrated in gratitude to Allah Most High. When I raised my head, he said: And Fatimah is in Paradise, so I prostrated. When I raised my head, he said: And al-Hasan and al-Husayn are the two masters of the youths of Paradise, so I prostrated. When I raised my head, he said: And whoever loves them is in Paradise, so I prostrated. When I raised my head, he said: And whoever loves those who love them is in Paradise.

key_terms.سَيِّدَا شَبَابِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ: the two masters of the youths of Paradise

ai.seo_question: Why did the Prophet perform five prostrations during a journey?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates that during a journey, the Prophet Muhammad performed five consecutive prostrations of gratitude after the angel Jibreel brought him glad tidings about his family: Ali is in Paradise, Fatimah is in Paradise, al-Hasan and al-Husayn are the masters of the youths of Paradise, those who love them are in Paradise, and those who love their lovers are in Paradise. Each revelation prompted a prostration of thanks. The hadith was narrated by Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq and transmitted through multiple scholars.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 2. He said: Abul Qasim Ja’far ibn Muhammad ibn Qawlawayh (may Allah bless him with mercy) reported to me from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn Amir, from Ahmad ibn Alawiyyah, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi, who reported from Tawabah ibn al-Khaleel, who reported from Uthman ibn Isa who reported from Abu Abdil Rehman, who reported from Ja’far ibn Muhammad (A.S.) that:

Once when the Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, was travelling, he dismounted and then performed five prostrations (Sijdah). When he mounted again, one of his companions said: "We saw you do something, O messenger of Allah, which you never did before." He said: "Yes, Jibraeel came to me and gave me glad news that ‘Ali belongs in Paradise. So I went into prostration to thank Allah. When I raised my head, he said: ’Fatimah belongs in Paradise.’ I went to prostrate again to thank Allah. And when I raised my head, he said: ’al-Hasan and al-Husayn are the masters of the youths of Paradise.’ So I prostrated to thank Allah. And when I raised my head, he said: ’And those who love them belong in Paradise.’ So I prostrated to thank Allah. And when I raised my head, he said: ’And those who love the people who love them (Ahlul Bayt) belong in Paradise.’ (So I prostrated to thank Allah)."
